criteria.text: The evaluation catalog covers every existing proposal kind, including tools and permissions.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c1: the closed evaluation catalog includes every existing proposal kind including tool installation

criteria.text: A configurable whole-run token cap reserves capacity for independent final validation before admitting exploration calls.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c2: exploration admission preserves the final-validation allocation

criteria.text: Concurrent candidate children share one atomic token limit, including outstanding reservations.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c3: concurrent children cannot reserve beyond the whole-run cap

criteria.text: Token reservation and settlement are idempotent after retries and restarts; a reused key with different terms is rejected.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c4: retrying a reservation or settlement after restart is idempotent

criteria.text: Missing provider usage stops evaluation as inconclusive and cannot produce a human-queue proposal.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c5: missing provider usage fails closed and retains the original

criteria.text: Actual usage replaces a reservation once, and usage above the reserved ceiling prevents qualification.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c6: actual usage settles once; an overrun cannot qualify

criteria.text: Original and candidate configuration versions and actual execution receipts are immutable, attributable, and recoverable.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c7: candidate versions and execution receipts remain immutable and recoverable

criteria.text: Concurrent coordinator updates cannot overwrite a qualification or human-queue identity without a matching job revision.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c8: CAS prevents concurrent qualification or queue identity overwrite

criteria.text: The original and two or three isolated candidate configurations execute real task and effect adapters, with actual tool and permission outcomes recorded.
criteria.reason: Requires the isolated real-engine/API sandbox and owned task fixtures; source or mocked tests cannot prove actual execution.

criteria.text: Composition records retained portions and evidence, then a separate final-versus-original validation on held-out tasks gates the exact proposed version.
criteria.reason: Requires the coordinator, real isolated executions, held-out fixtures, and queue readback in the sandbox.

criteria.text: The packaged review UI can configure the token limit and shows versions, execution results, token spend, and inconclusive reasons before a human decision.
criteria.reason: Requires the exact locally signed app with real API and engine, plus a checked packaged Playwright journey.

criteria.text: The reviewer diagnosis and multiple target evaluations share one durable root token cap, including concurrent child reservations.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c12: reviewer diagnosis and concurrent target children spend one root budget

criteria.text: Unknown usage in one target evaluation poisons the shared review-cycle budget and stops all sibling admissions.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c13: unknown child usage poisons the shared root and sibling admissions

criteria.text: A review cycle cannot close while a target child or provider reservation is active, and closing the cycle prevents new admissions.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c14: a review cycle closes only after every child and provider call finishes

criteria.text: A passing receipt must contain the full kind-specific observed-effect ledger; a tool install cannot qualify from profile projection alone.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c15: a tool install cannot pass on profile projection evidence alone

criteria.text: A partially correct final answer cannot qualify merely because it improves on the original; every final task must pass completely.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c16: a partial final output cannot qualify even when it improves the original

criteria.text: Workflow prompt improvements require actual managed-skill loading and execution rather than profile projection alone.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c17: a workflow prompt fix needs observed managed skill execution

criteria.text: Composition portions must match exact source and final bytes at a JSON Pointer and cite a source result that improved over its matching original task.
criteria.test_id: org-evaluation-c18: composition cannot claim copied portions absent from source bytes
